consequence.statement: Operations are an alpha feature providing new optional functionality for running operational workflows; existing deployments are not affected unless they adopt this feature.

assertion.statement: Crossplane v2.0.0 introduces Operations, a new way to run operational tasks using function pipelines, available as three alpha API kinds: Operation, CronOperation, and WatchOperation in the ops.crossplane.io/v1alpha1 group.
